name: io.github.dianlight/owa-exchange-mcp
title: OWA Exchange MCP Server
description: MCP server for Microsoft Exchange / OWA — email, calendar, directory, availability

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_OWA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your OWA instance (e.g. https://owa.example.com)

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_BROWSER_PROFILE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Path to the persistent browser profile directory (default: ~/owa-mcp/.browser-profile)

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_LOGIN_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds the interactive sign-in window waits for the user (default: 300)

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false/0 to run the browser with a visible window (for debugging)
